Middle East.headline: Seven killed, four wounded in gunfire attack on bus in Syria's Homs
Middle East.body: Seven people have been killed and four others injured after a bus came under "gunfire" in the countryside of Syria's western Homs province, the Syrian Arab News Agency reported. The bus was targeted near Masyaf Bridge, the agency said, citing a provincial health directorate source. Earlier, Syrian Alikhbaria TV reported that the attack was carried out by an "unidentified group." Civil defence teams were assisting the injured, while security forces secured and cordoned off the area, according to the broadcaster. Americas.headline: Mexico/United States — Hurricane Polo Causes Damage and Threatens Flash Floods Across US Midwest
Americas.body: Hurricane Polo struck Mexico’s Pacific coast and Baja California peninsula as a Category 3 storm with sustained winds of 125 mph, tearing roofs from homes, felling trees, and flooding roads before dissipating over northwest Mexico. The storm's remnants are tracking inland into the United States, posing a flash flood risk to roughly 100 million people from Arizona to Iowa. Forecasters expect between 4 and 6 inches of rainfall across parts of the Southern Plains and Midwest, with flash flood warnings issued in states including Texas and Oklahoma.

Americas.headline: United States (Hawaii) — Hurricane Nolo Prompts Weather Advisories for Big Island
Americas.body: Hurricane Nolo tracked southwest away from the Hawaiian Islands while maintaining maximum sustained winds near 105 mph. High-wind warnings, wind advisories, and high-surf advisories remained in effect across parts of Hawaii’s Big Island as the storm moved further away, bringing risks of high winds and surf.

Americas.headline: Canada — Ebola-Related Border Restrictions Extended for Central and East African Travelers
Americas.body: The Canadian government extended temporary immigration and border measures until November 27 for travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The 60-day extension announced by Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada suspends processing for certain immigration documents and travel applications while enforcing enhanced entry screening, citing ongoing public health risks from an Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak.

Africa.headline: Ebola outbreak exceeds 8,000 cases
Africa.body: KINSHASA, DR Congo (AFP) — The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has logged more than 8,000 cases of Ebola, including almost 4,000 deaths, amid the worst outbreak in the country’s history, according to data from the Congolese authorities seen by Agence France-Presse on Monday. In mid-May, the DRC officially declared its 17th Ebola breakout, a deadly disease that has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past 50 years. To date, authorities have recorded 8,067 cases — including 3,901 deaths and 2,070 recoveries — since the start of the current crisis, representing a fatality rate of 48.4 percent, the latest official data showed. Europe.headline: Three earthquakes strike Russia
Europe.body: Three earthquakes strike Russia Three earthquakes were recorded off the eastern coast of Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula in the Pacific Ocean, with the strongest measuring magnitude 5.6, according to Russia’s Academy of Sciences. The earthquakes occurred within a few minutes of one another in the Pacific waters off Kamchatka, one of Russia’s most seismically active regions. The regional branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences’ Unified Geophysical Service reported the seismic activity, providing details on the magnitude and location of the tremors. Europe.headline: Ukraine persists with Russian oil refinery strikes, defying Trump on fuel price warnings
Europe.body: Kyiv’s long-range strikes are headache for Trump before crucial midterms, while analysts’ claim war in Iran is responsible for rising prices Europe live – latest updates Ukraine is pressing on with strikes on Russian oil refineries, defying Donald Trump, who blames the attacks for exacerbating a global diesel shortage and pushing up fuel prices. Kyiv struck an oil facility in Russia’s southern Samara region overnight, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Thursday in a statement on social media. The Ukrainian president added that a Russian vessel in the Black Sea was hit, as well as a launch and storage site for attack drones in the Oryol region. Continue reading...

Europe.headline: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
Europe.body: Russia launched its heaviest combined assault on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure in months on Wednesday, killing seven people and triggering emergency power cuts in Kyiv and nearby regions. The strikes came as officials warned of a difficult winter amid Russian attacks on Ukraine’s power and heating infrastructure.

Asia-Pacific.headline: Myanmar — Military airstrike on Rakhine market kills dozens
Asia-Pacific.body: At least 49 people were killed and 58 others injured, including 22 in critical condition, after a Myanmar military fighter jet dropped two bombs near a crowded market in rebel-held Kyauktaw, Rakhine State. The market was filled with shopkeepers and shoppers when the attack occurred. Relief workers and the Arakan Army reported the casualty numbers, which have not been independently verified. UN representatives condemned the strike targeting civilians and urged an immediate end to forced repatriations of Myanmar nationals from abroad.

Asia-Pacific.headline: Afghanistan — Pakistani airstrikes kill women and children in border region
Asia-Pacific.body: Pakistani air attacks in Afghanistan killed at least nine women and children and wounded 11 other people, according to Afghan Taliban officials. The strikes represent a notable escalation along the border regions between the two countries. Protection concerns remain elevated for civilians residing near active military operations in the border zone.

Asia-Pacific.headline: India — Measles and malaria outbreaks cause 32 child deaths
Asia-Pacific.body: At least 32 children have died in India's Balaghat district since May due to severe outbreaks of measles and malaria. The deaths occurred across remote forest villages, where compounded disease risks continue to threaten vulnerable pediatric populations with limited healthcare access.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: Democratic Republic of the Congo — Ebola Outbreak Exceeds 8,000 Cases
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is confronting the worst Ebola outbreak in its history, with official data indicating more than 8,000 recorded cases and nearly 4,000 deaths since the outbreak was declared in mid-May. Originating in northeastern Ituri province, the crisis has recorded a case fatality rate of 48.4 percent. Additionally, Médecins Sans Frontières confirmed that a staff responder in the DRC tested positive for Bundibugyo virus disease and was medically evacuated to the Netherlands for specialized treatment under strict isolation protocols.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: South Sudan — Cholera Cases Decline Following Response Interventions
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: South Sudan is making progress against a cholera outbreak active since June, with the World Health Organization reporting a steady decline in cases since late July. More than 1,500 cases have been recorded overall, with children under nine years old representing the most affected group in Juba and Bor counties. Health officials attribute the reduced transmission to improved access to safe drinking water, sanitation facilities, and timely medical care.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: Zambia — Government Declares New Cholera Outbreak Across Five Provinces
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: Zambian authorities have declared a new cholera outbreak after recording 304 cases and 11 deaths across seven districts in five provinces. The outbreak originated in August from an imported case in Lusaka traced to Chibombo District. Health officials noted that eight of the 11 deaths occurred within local communities prior to hospital admission. Active transmission is currently confirmed in Lusaka, Chilanga, Chongwe, Chibombo, Chiengi, Nsama, and Chikankata districts.
